recommendations.title: Direct R processes exit 139 after valid output
recommendations.problem: Five fresh direct r.sh invocations wrote complete parseable output then returned exit 139.
recommendations.root_cause: The failure appears during shared-R native teardown, after computation/output, rather than before a source-level result.
recommendations.fix: Reproduce in a clean user-target R 4.4.3/Bioc 3.20 stack and identify the unloading dependency. Until resolved, validate expected output files after R exits and never conceal the nonzero status.

recommendations.title: Self-contained msqrob2 demo realizes 7% FDR once
recommendations.problem: The fixed seed prints 43 calls with 3 planted false positives (7.0%) at nominal 5%; it does not claim calibration but can be overread.
recommendations.root_cause: One compact illustrative simulation is not a calibration benchmark.
recommendations.fix: Optionally label this printed FDR as an illustrative realization; retain larger planted-truth regressions for calibration evidence.
